IP_WILDCARD_UNSUPPORTED.zh-CN: IP 地址不能使用通配符

UPSTREAM_QUERY_UNSUPPORTED.zh-CN: 上游不能包含查询或片段
UPSTREAM_QUERY_UNSUPPORTED.en-US: The upstream URL cannot contain a query or fragment.

UPSTREAM_SCHEME_INVALID.zh-CN: 上游只支持不含凭据的 HTTP/HTTPS URL
UPSTREAM_SCHEME_INVALID.en-US: Use an HTTP/HTTPS upstream URL without credentials.

UPSTREAM_CHARACTERS_INVALID.zh-CN: 上游地址包含无效字符
UPSTREAM_CHARACTERS_INVALID.en-US: The upstream URL contains invalid characters.

SITE_CODE_INVALID.zh-CN: 代号须为 1–128 位字母、数字、点、短横线或下划线，以字母或数字开头
SITE_CODE_INVALID.en-US: The code must be 1–128 letters, digits, dots, hyphens or underscores, starting with a letter or digit.

SITE_SAVE_INTERRUPTED.en-US: The website save task was interrupted.

SITE_CREATE_INTERRUPTED.en-US: The website creation task was interrupted.

SITE_CODE_IMMUTABLE.zh-CN: 创建后不能修改代号；修改域名不影响代号和目录
SITE_CODE_IMMUTABLE.en-US: The code cannot be changed after creation. Domain changes do not affect the code or directory.

SITE_DELETE_INTERRUPTED.en-US: The website deletion task was interrupted.

BACKUP_CONFIGURATION_BUSY.en-US: Wait for the configuration change to finish before backing up.

LISTENER_PROTOCOL_CONFLICT.zh-CN: 同一监听端口不能混用 HTTP 和 HTTPS
LISTENER_PROTOCOL_CONFLICT.en-US: HTTP and HTTPS cannot share the same listening port.

LISTENER_DOMAIN_CONFLICT.zh-CN: 同一监听端口存在重复域名
LISTENER_DOMAIN_CONFLICT.en-US: Duplicate domains on the same listening port.

LISTENER_ADDRESS_CONFLICT.zh-CN: 同端口不能混用通配 IP 和具体 IP
LISTENER_ADDRESS_CONFLICT.en-US: Wildcard and specific IP addresses cannot share a port.

HASH_BUCKET_SIZE_INVALID.zh-CN: 域名哈希桶大小必须为 32～65536 之间的 2 的幂
HASH_BUCKET_SIZE_INVALID.en-US: The domain hash bucket size must be a power of two between 32 and 65536.

DOMAIN_REQUIRED.en-US: Enter a domain or IP address.

DOMAIN_TOO_LONG.zh-CN: 域名或 IP 长度超出限制
DOMAIN_TOO_LONG.en-US: The domain or IP address exceeds the length limit.

DOMAIN_NOT_NORMALIZED.en-US: The domain has not been normalized.

ENGINE_CONFIRMATION_TIMEOUT.zh-CN: 引擎未确认加载新配置
ENGINE_CONFIRMATION_TIMEOUT.en-US: Nginx did not confirm that the new configuration was loaded.

CERTIFICATE_REFERENCE_MISSING.en-US: The referenced certificate does not exist.

PERFORMANCE_OUT_OF_RANGE.zh-CN: 性能参数超出允许范围
PERFORMANCE_OUT_OF_RANGE.en-US: A performance parameter is outside the allowed range.

PERFORMANCE_SAVE_INTERRUPTED.zh-CN: 性能配置保存任务中断
PERFORMANCE_SAVE_INTERRUPTED.en-US: The performance configuration task was interrupted.

FILES_BUSY.en-US: The file operation is busy. Try again later.

BACKUP_RESPONSE_FAILED.en-US: The backup download response could not be created.

MIGRATION_DIRECTORY_CONFLICT.zh-CN: 旧目录和目标目录同时存在，停止迁移以保留文件
MIGRATION_DIRECTORY_CONFLICT.en-US: Both the old and target directories exist. Migration stopped to preserve files.

ENGINE_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE.zh-CN: 未连接 Agent Runtime，无法控制引擎
ENGINE_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE.en-US: The Agent Runtime is not connected. Nginx cannot be controlled.

AUTHORITY_NOT_FOUND.en-US: The root certificate does not exist.

AUTHORITY_KEY_MISMATCH.en-US: The root certificate and private key do not match.

AUTHORITY_CREATE_INTERRUPTED.en-US: The root certificate creation task was interrupted.

AUTHORITY_NAME_INVALID.zh-CN: 根证书名称须为 1–64 字节，不含控制字符
AUTHORITY_NAME_INVALID.en-US: The root certificate name must be 1–64 bytes without control characters.

AUTHORITY_NOT_VALID.zh-CN: 根证书尚未生效或已经过期
AUTHORITY_NOT_VALID.en-US: The root certificate is not yet valid or has expired.

AUTHORITY_VALIDITY_INVALID.zh-CN: 根证书有效期须为 1–99 年
AUTHORITY_VALIDITY_INVALID.en-US: Root certificate validity must be 1–99 years.

AUTHORITY_GENERATE_INTERRUPTED.en-US: The root certificate generation task was interrupted.

PRIVATE_KEY_INVALID.zh-CN: 私钥 PEM 无效或需要密码
PRIVATE_KEY_INVALID.en-US: The private key PEM is invalid or password protected.

ORGANIZATION_INVALID.zh-CN: 组织须为 0–128 字节，不含控制字符
ORGANIZATION_INVALID.en-US: The organization must be 0–128 bytes without control characters.

SITE_REVISION_INVALID.en-US: The website revision is outside the allowed range.

SITE_NAME_INVALID.zh-CN: 网站名称须为 1–128 字节
SITE_NAME_INVALID.en-US: The website name must be 1–128 bytes.

SITE_DIRECTORY_SYMLINK.zh-CN: 网站目录及其父目录不能为软链接
SITE_DIRECTORY_SYMLINK.en-US: The website directory and its parents cannot be symbolic links.

CERTIFICATE_VALIDITY_INVALID.zh-CN: 网站证书有效期须为 1–99 年

CERTIFICATE_IN_USE.en-US: The certificate is still used by a website.

CERTIFICATE_KEY_MISMATCH.en-US: The certificate and private key do not match.

CERTIFICATE_NOT_VALID.zh-CN: 证书尚未生效或已经过期
CERTIFICATE_NOT_VALID.en-US: The certificate is not yet valid or has expired.

CERTIFICATE_SERIAL_INVALID.en-US: The certificate serial number could not be parsed.

CERTIFICATE_FINGERPRINT_INVALID.en-US: The certificate fingerprint could not be parsed.

CERTIFICATE_TIME_INVALID.en-US: The certificate time could not be parsed.

CERTIFICATE_TIME_OUT_OF_RANGE.en-US: The certificate time is outside the supported range.

CERTIFICATE_VALIDITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.en-US: The certificate validity is outside the supported range.

CERTIFICATE_ISSUE_INTERRUPTED.en-US: The certificate issuance task was interrupted.

CERTIFICATE_CHAIN_EMPTY.en-US: The certificate chain cannot be empty.

SITE_DIRECTORY_EXISTS.zh-CN: 该代号对应的目录已存在，请修改代号或先在文件管理中处理保留文件
SITE_DIRECTORY_EXISTS.en-US: This code's directory already exists. Choose another code or manage the retained files in File Manager.

DOMAIN_INPUT_INVALID.zh-CN: 请输入域名或 IPv4 地址，不含协议、端口和路径
DOMAIN_INPUT_INVALID.en-US: Enter a domain or IPv4 address without a scheme, port or path.

PATH_OUTSIDE_SITE.zh-CN: 路径必须位于网站 index 内
PATH_OUTSIDE_SITE.en-US: The path must remain inside the website index directory.

MIGRATION_SOURCE_MISSING.en-US: The migration source directory does not exist.

MIGRATION_DOMAIN_REQUIRED.en-US: Migration requires a primary website domain.

RUN_DIRECTORY_INVALID.zh-CN: 运行目录包含无效字符
RUN_DIRECTORY_INVALID.en-US: The document root contains invalid characters.

DOMAIN_COUNT_INVALID.zh-CN: 需要 1–64 个域名或 IP

ADVANCED_CONFIGURATION_TOO_LARGE.en-US: The advanced configuration is too large.

DEFAULT_AUTHORITY_KEY_MISMATCH.zh-CN: 默认根证书和私钥不匹配，请从备份恢复
DEFAULT_AUTHORITY_KEY_MISMATCH.en-US: The built-in root certificate and private key do not match. Restore them from a backup.

SITE_CODE_EXISTS.zh-CN: 代号 {code} 已被使用，请修改代号
SITE_CODE_EXISTS.en-US: The code {code} is already in use. Choose another code.

DOMAIN_ALREADY_BOUND.zh-CN: 端口 {port} 上的域名 {domain} 已绑定网站
DOMAIN_ALREADY_BOUND.en-US: The domain {domain} is already bound on port {port}.

SITE_CREATE_FAILED_FILES_KEPT.en-US: {cause}; website files have been retained at {path}.

SITE_FILES_CLEANUP_FAILED.zh-CN: 网站已删除，文件清理失败，请在文件管理中处理：{reason}
SITE_FILES_CLEANUP_FAILED.en-US: The website was deleted, but file cleanup failed. Use File Manager: {reason}

RUN_DIRECTORY_MISSING.zh-CN: 网站 {name} 的运行目录不存在
RUN_DIRECTORY_MISSING.en-US: The document root for website {name} does not exist.

CONFIGURATION_CONFLICT.zh-CN: 配置修订号已变化，请刷新后重试
CONFIGURATION_CONFLICT.en-US: The configuration has changed. Refresh and try again.

INTERNAL_ERROR.zh-CN: 服务内部错误，请检查管理服务日志
INTERNAL_ERROR.en-US: Internal service error. Check the manager logs.

UNAUTHORIZED.zh-CN: 会话已失效，请重新打开套件
UNAUTHORIZED.en-US: The session has expired. Reopen the suite.

NETWORK_ERROR.zh-CN: 网络请求失败，请检查连接后重试
NETWORK_ERROR.en-US: Network request failed. Check the connection and try again.
